spec.name: sprint47_qhour_open_majors_v1
spec.hypothesis: Quarter-hour boundary algo flow (arXiv 2607.09426) produces continuation on liquid majors when prior-interval drift and taker imbalance agree. Majors only, since the altcoin and tail-liquidity qhour cells are already registered.
spec.power_argument: Assumed per-trade sigma ~15bp (not measured). n>=300 validation trades (about 4 symbols x 90 days x 2/day = 720 projected). Min detectable edge at t=2, 80% power: 2.8*15/sqrt(300) ~= 2.4bp net (about 1.6bp at n=720). T1 round trip is about 4bp with slippage. A pass is not a deployable verdict without a maker fill-rate argument. The criteria can fail under the null: the research and validation signs must match, and C0 must stay a FAIL.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
